title: Korean-Style Pork Jjigae
description: A spicy and savory Korean stew made with pork and gochujang, served with a side of steamed rice.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add pork and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove pork from pan and set aside.
Add gochujang, chili flakes, and 1 tablespoon soy sauce to pan.
Cook, stirring constantly, until sauce is smooth and fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add 1 cup water to pan and bring to a boil.
Return pork to pan and simmer, covered, until tender, about 20 minutes.
Stir in remaining 1 tablespoon soy sauce and brown sugar (if using).
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with green onions and serve over steamed rice.
